fixtures.purpose: Deny service use when exact principal has no grant.
Signing, provenance and licence metadata never create runtime authority.
A parent principal grant does not authorize a contained child Behaviour.
Target, operation and byte dimensions are enforced together.
Delegated scope only narrows and lifetime never widens.
Non-delegable child grant cannot delegate further.
Delegation depth is bounded before new-grant allocation.
Delegation descendant count is bounded before new-grant allocation.
Trusted grant snapshots reject missing ancestry.
Trusted grant snapshots reject cyclic ancestry without unbounded traversal.
Ancestor revocation invalidates descendant leases immediately.
Ancestor expiry invalidates descendant leases immediately.
Required capability denial fails preflight explicitly.
Optional capability denial may select only an explicitly declared reduced mode.
ServiceRequest principal is derived from ThingId plus BehaviourAttachmentId origin.
Admission performs authorization but never invokes the host adapter.
Revocation after admission wins at the final pre-host recheck.
Expiry after admission wins at the final pre-host recheck.
Recursive serialized capability/host/session authority is rejected at service ingress.
A copied grant ID in payload cannot launder another principal's authority.
Pending and admission-window service quotas are principal-scoped and pre-allocation.
Unknown services and out-of-scope requests fail before host use.
Consumed admitted calls cannot be replayed.
Raw host objects and exception details do not cross back into ordinary content.
